descriptionChirho: A Hebrew proper name meaning 'he saves' or 'salvation', a contracted form of Yehoshua (Joshua). Refers to several individuals in post-exilic literature, most prominently the high priest Jeshua son of Jozadak who returned from Babylonian exile (Ezra 2-3, Neh 7, Hag 1-2, Zech 3, 6). All grammatical variants — nominative, with conjunction (and-Yeshua), with prepositions (for-Yeshua, in-Yeshua) — denote the same proper name. Multilingual renderings are consistent: eng 'Yeshua/Jeshua', spa 'Jesua', hin 'yeshua' (येशूआ), arb 'Yashua' (يَشُوعَ), kor 'Yesua' (예수아/예슈아), swa 'Yeshua/Yoshua'.
